Gifted: Chain.description:
🧬 Chain, as an extra Quirk put into your body.

🌱 At the start you can swing from a beam or flick a short loop across a sparring pad.
📈 With training: paired cuffs, a stretcher sling, a handrail over a gap, and a four-chain catch for a collapsing walkway.
⚠️ Two lines reach four meters each at first. Training brings that to four lines of twelve meters. Each bears one adult, provided its anchor holds.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Visible Tell. If chosen, the first link rattles before you cast.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Hanta Sero (Tape), for the midair change of direction.

⚠️ Less practiced than your main Quirk: no technique cards of its own; the story plays it from its rules.
Gifted: Chain.traitNarrativeEffects: Gifted extra Quirk (Chain family): Scale: Two solid chains, four meters each, from palms or forearms. Trained casts reach twelve meters on up to four lines. Limits: Links hook or loop around solid features. A smooth wall offers no purchase. One adult per line, including the user. Slack lets a captive slip out. Dismissed links vanish. Nothing past a chain's length can be hooked or reached (a 50-meter dash is out of reach): the user closes the distance first. Quirk Strain: light: Rafter Pendulum, Knuckle Rattle; moderate: Buckle Catch, Signal Chain, Switchback Swing; heavy: Silver Litter, Bell Rope Lash, Balcony Handrail, Twin Arrest, Portcullis Rattle; severe: Four Corners Catch. Type: Emitter. Law: Closing a public exit with chains can trap people inside. Look: Blue links flash silver as slack comes out.
